name: comp-203
blurb: Select dropdown with label and default value pre-selected.
description: Basic Select with Label, SelectTrigger with SelectValue, and SelectContent with four framework options. Default value is pre-selected.
use_when: You need a simple select with a sensible default already chosen.
avoid_when: When users must explicitly choose; use a placeholder-based select instead.
a11y: Label linked via htmlFor. SelectValue accessible. Full keyboard navigation.
